item.title: Patoka Visits MICA
item.description: Jewish Baltimore County Councilman Izzy Patoka of District 2 attended the Maryland Institute College of Art’s bicentennial gala last weekend. He is seen here posing with one of the works. (Courtesy of Izzy Patoka) The post Patoka Visits MICA appeared first on Baltimore Jewish Times.

item.title: Italy Sees Record 963 Antisemitic Incidents in 2025
item.description: Canaan Lidor Italy’s Jewish community documented a record high of 963 antisemitic incidents in 2025 — a 10% increase over 2024 — which a communal leader on Thursday attributed to biased media coverage on Israel.
